description_en: Removes the access permissions on an account in a resource directory
description_zh: 调用DeleteAccessAssignment移除RD账号上的授权
kebab_example: aliyun cloudsso delete-access-assignment --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --access-configuration-id ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj0000 --target-type RD-Account --target-id 1142405247840000 --principal-type User --principal-id u-00q8wbq42wiltcrk0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteAccessAssignment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access configuration
parameters.name: access_configuration_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the task object. Set the value to RD-Account, which specifies the accounts in the resource directory
parameters.help_zh: 任务目标类型。取值：RD-Account，表示任务目标类型为RD账号
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task object
parameters.name: target_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the CloudSSO identity. Valid values:

User

Group
parameters.help_zh:
云SSO身份类型。取值：

User：用户。
Group：用户组
parameters.name: principal_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the CloudSSO identity.

If you set `PrincipalType` to `User`, set `PrincipalId` to the ID of the CloudSSO user.

If you set `PrincipalType` to `Group`, set `PrincipalId` to the ID of the CloudSSO group
parameters.help_zh:
云SSO身份ID。具体如下：

当`PrincipalType`为`User`时，`PrincipalId`为云SSO用户ID。
当`PrincipalType`为`Group`时，`PrincipalId`为云SSO用户组ID
parameters.name: principal_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to de-provision the access configuration when you remove the access permissions from the CloudSSO identity. The access configuration is used to assign the access permissions, and the identity is the only one that uses the access configuration and is associated with the account. Valid values:

DeprovisionForLastAccessAssignmentOnAccount: de-provisions the access configuration.

None: does not de-provision the access configuration. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
当您移除一个RD账号上使用某访问配置的最后一个授权时，是否同时解除访问配置部署。取值：

DeprovisionForLastAccessAssignmentOnAccount：解除访问配置部署。
None（默认值）：不解除访问配置部署
parameters.name: deprovision_strategy
